description: Origami is an AI prospecting and outbound platform for finding leads, enriching contacts, generating outreach, and running LinkedIn and email campaigns. It also supports CRM export/push workflows and mailbox provisioning within the product.
summary: Origami exposes a bearer-authenticated HTTP API at https://origami.chat/api/v3, an OAuth-protected/self-onboarding MCP server at https://origami.chat/mcp (also documented to accept the same bearer API key), and an `origami` CLI authenticated via `ORIGAMI_API_KEY`.
